title: Top Sleeping Bags for Cold Nights (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Selected products were chosen from the six provided sources, prioritizing those mentioned by more than one site and evaluating their warmth, weight, and packability as described.
assumptions: Prices are not listed in the sources, so no cost comparison is made.

verdict.line: Picture a 15‑degree winter night on a backcountry ridge—this bag keeps you warm and light, making it ideal for solo or pair hikes. It offers a 30‑degree rating, a roomy 2‑person size, and a lightweight down core that outperforms the other picks in warmth‑to‑weight ratio. The catch: it is heavier than the ultra‑light options.
